why: Wave-based symbol matching turns Ramp AP Agents into fast triage: every invoice threat needs the right approve, reject, dedupe, or code action before it reaches finance.
title: Invoice Ghost Zapper
subtitle: Draw the right action to clear bills before they hit the ledger.
closing_stat: Ramp AP Agents cleared {score} bills while finance only touched the exceptions.
art_style: spooky-cute flat cartoon with chunky invoice ghosts, bold outlines, purple-and-green night-office palette, glowing ledger UI, and playful finance details

feature_explainer.headline: Ramp AP Agents / Bill Pay
bullets: AI agents sort real invoices from fraud and duplicates automatically.
Line items get coded into the right buckets and routed for approval or rejection.
Finance teams only step in for the exceptions.
